english.title: Fail to comply with notice / requirement to join rear of queue on Transport for London road transport premises
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) when

(A)_[directed to queue by a notice]_
(B)_[asked to queue by an authorised person]_

(C)_[failed to join the rear of a queue]_
(D)_[failed to join the rear of a queue and obey the reasonable instructions of an authorised person regulating that queue]_

on or near Transport for London road transport premises situated at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 1(2) and 14 of the Transport for London Road Transport Premises Byelaws made under paragraph 26 of Schedule 11 to the Greater London Authority Act 1999 and confirmed under section 67 of the Transport Act 1962.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
when directed to queue by a notice while on/near Transport for London road transport premises OR
when asked to queue by an authorised person to join the rear of a queue
failed to obey the reasonable instructions of an authorised person regulating that queue
on/near Transport for London road transport premises

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Byelaw 13 for the provision of a name and address by persons suspected of breaching this byelaw.
(ii) See byelaw 15 for a power to remove persons breaching this byelaw
(iii) See byelaw 16 for the requirement for authorised persons exercising any power conferred any of the Byelaws to produce a form of identification when requested to do so.
(iv) See Byelaw 17 in relation to the provision of notices.
english.standardstatementoffacts:

(C)_[failed to join the rear of a queue]_

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
